SELECT * FROM EDS.CUST_PRODUCT_COUNT_VW 

CREATE VIEW EDS.CUST_PRODUCT_COUNT_VW AS
SELECT AS_OF_DATE, CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(DEP_ACCT_CNT) DEP_COUNT,  SUM(LNS_ACCT_CNT) LNS_COUNT,  SUM(CCD_ACCT_CNT) CCD_COUNT, 
SUM(TRU_ACCT_CNT) TRU_COUNT, SUM(TRY_ACCT_CNT) TRY_COUNT
FROM 
(
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE, CUSTOMER_ID, DEP_ACCT_CNT, 0 LNS_ACCT_CNT, 0 CCD_ACCT_CNT, 0 TRU_ACCT_CNT, 0 TRY_ACCT_CNT FROM (
											SELECT
											EDA.AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
											,ORGKEY AS CUSTOMER_ID
											,COUNT(FORACID) AS DEP_ACCT_CNT
											FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
											INNER JOIN (SELECT LEAST(DEPOSITS_DATE,LOANS_DATE,CCD_DATE,TRU_DATE,TRY_DATE) LEAST_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL) CD
												ON  EDA.AS_OF_DATE = CD.LEAST_DATE
											LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
												ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
												AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
												AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
											LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
												ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
												AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
												AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
											WHERE 
												EDA.DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
												AND EDA.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
												AND GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL
												AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'

											GROUP BY 
												EDA.AS_OF_DATE
												,ORGKEY
										) DEP
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE, CUSTOMER_ID, 0 DEP_ACCT_CNT, LNS_ACCT_CNT, 0 CCD_ACCT_CNT, 0 TRU_ACCT_CNT, 0 TRY_ACCT_CNT FROM (
											SELECT
											A.AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
											,C.ORGKEY AS CUSTOMER_ID
											,COUNT(B.FORACID) AS LNS_ACCT_CNT
											FROM EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN A
											INNER JOIN (SELECT LEAST(DEPOSITS_DATE,LOANS_DATE,CCD_DATE,TRU_DATE,TRY_DATE) LEAST_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL) CD
												ON  A.AS_OF_DATE = CD.LEAST_DATE
												LEFT JOIN EDS.LOAN_FACT B
													ON A.AS_OF_DATE = B.AS_OF_DATE
													AND A.ACID = B.GAM_ACID
													AND A.BANK_ID = B.GAM_BANK_ID
												LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM C
													ON A.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN C.SCD_START_DATE AND C.SCD_END_DATE
													AND A.CUST_ID = C.CORE_CUST_ID
													AND A.BANK_ID = C.BANK_ID
												LEFT JOIN EDS.BRANCH_DIM D
													ON B.SOL_ID = D.SOL_ID
													AND B.GAM_BANK_ID = D.BANK_ID
											WHERE A.DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
												AND A.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
												AND B.GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL
												--AND (LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' AND LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS IS NOT NULL)
												AND A.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
											GROUP BY 
												A.AS_OF_DATE
												,C.ORGKEY
										) LNS
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE, CUSTOMER_ID, 0 DEP_ACCT_CNT, 0 LNS_ACCT_CNT, CCD_ACCT_CNT, 0 TRU_ACCT_CNT, 0 TRY_ACCT_CNT FROM (
											SELECT
											AS_OF_DATE
											,CUST_CIF_NBR AS CUSTOMER_ID
											,COUNT(CRDACCT_NBR) AS CCD_ACCT_CNT
											FROM EDS.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT A
											INNER JOIN (SELECT LEAST(DEPOSITS_DATE,LOANS_DATE,CCD_DATE,TRU_DATE,TRY_DATE) LEAST_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL) CD
												ON  A.AS_OF_DATE = CD.LEAST_DATE
											GROUP BY
											 AS_OF_DATE
											,CUST_CIF_NBR
										) CCD
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE, CUSTOMER_ID, 0 DEP_ACCT_CNT, 0 LNS_ACCT_CNT, 0 CCD_ACCT_CNT, TRU_ACCT_CNT, 0 TRY_ACCT_CNT  FROM (
											SELECT 
											CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(CUST.FILE_NAME,12),8) AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE
											,CUST.UNIQUE_ID AS CUSTOMER_ID
											,COUNT(PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO) AS TRU_ACCT_CNT
												FROM busc.TRU_CUST AS CUST
											INNER JOIN (SELECT LEAST(DEPOSITS_DATE,LOANS_DATE,CCD_DATE,TRU_DATE,TRY_DATE) LEAST_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL) CD
												ON  CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(CUST.FILE_NAME,12),8) AS DATE) = CD.LEAST_DATE
												LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_BASELINK AS BASE
													ON CUST.CUST_NO = BASE.CIF_NO
													AND BASE.ISLATEST = 1 AND BASE.ISACTIVE = 1
												LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_PORTFOLIO AS PORT
													ON BASE.CUST_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
													AND PORT.ISLATEST = 1 AND PORT.ISACTIVE = 1
												LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION PFSUB
													ON PORT.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = PFSUB.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
													AND PORT.BASE_NO = PFSUB.BASE_NO
												LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_AUMNONUITF AS NONUITF
													ON NONUITF.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
													AND NONUITF.PF_NO = PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
													AND NONUITF.ISLATEST = 1 AND NONUITF.ISACTIVE = 1
												LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_AUMUITF AS UITF
													ON UITF.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
													AND UITF.PORTFOLIO_NO = PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
													AND UITF.ISLATEST = 1 AND UITF.ISACTIVE = 1
											WHERE CUST.ISACTIVE = 1 AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1
												AND PORT.STATUS = 'A'
											GROUP BY
												CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(CUST.FILE_NAME,12),8) AS DATE)
												,CUST.UNIQUE_ID
										) TRU
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE, CUSTOMER_ID, 0 DEP_ACCT_CNT, 0 LNS_ACCT_CNT, 0 CCD_ACCT_CNT, 0 TRU_ACCT_CNT, TRY_ACCT_CNT FROM (
										SELECT
										CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(LE.FILE_NAME,12),8) AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE,
										LE.EXTERNAL_REF AS CUSTOMER_ID,
										COUNT(LE.ID) AS TRY_ACCT_CNT
										from busc.TRY_LEGALENTITY AS LE
										INNER JOIN (SELECT LEAST(DEPOSITS_DATE,LOANS_DATE,CCD_DATE,TRU_DATE,TRY_DATE) LEAST_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL) CD
											ON  CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(LE.FILE_NAME,12),8) AS DATE) = CD.LEAST_DATE
										LEFT JOIN busc.TRY_TRADES TRADES
												ON LE.ID = TRADES.COUNTERPARTY_ID
										WHERE TRADES.CounterParty_ID IS NOT NULL AND TRADES.ISACTIVE = 1
										AND LE.ISLATEST = 1 AND LE.ISACTIVE = 1
										AND LE.STATUS = 'ENABLED' AND LE.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
										GROUP BY 
											CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(LE.FILE_NAME,12),8) AS DATE),
											LE.EXTERNAL_REF
									)TRY ) A
    WHERE LEFT(CUSTOMER_ID,1) = 'R' --Retail
GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE, CUSTOMER_ID
